safe_title: Finite Arithmetic Capacity under Additive Locally Constant, Good-Reduction Multiplier, and Algebraic-Action Readouts
paper_role: scoped additive capacity theorem and machine-auditable architecture certificate
positioning: moderate synthesis and certificate novelty; no component priority, universal no-go theorem, complete trichotomy, or Hilbert-Polya construction claim

version_history.v1_disposition: selector theorem correct but demoted to a corollary after independent review

primary_theorem.name: additive finite arithmetic-capacity bound
primary_theorem.hit_semantics: P_hit is a set of distinct positive rational primes; repeated orbit hits and repeated certificates do not increase its cardinality
primary_theorem.statement: If every realized prime p has a representation log(p)=v_p+log(q_p)+alpha_p with v_p in one fixed finite-dimensional Q-space V, q_p a positive real algebraic number whose square is an S_Q-unit for one fixed finite rational-prime set S_Q, and alpha_p real algebraic, then cardinality(P_hit) <= dim_Q(V)+cardinality(S_Q).
primary_theorem.certificate_selection: choose one arbitrary valid representation for each distinct prime before examining any finite rational relation
proof_spine: remove the at most cardinality(S_Q) hit primes inside S_Q
clear denominators in a hypothetical Q-linear relation among the selected v_p terms
substitute the certificates to obtain log(R)=beta with R positive algebraic and beta real algebraic
Hermite-Lindemann forces beta=0 and hence R=1
square the algebraic identity so that only certified q_p^2 terms occur
pass the finitely many factors to one number field and preserve unit status by extension invariance
at a place over each distinct outside prime, valuation isolation forces its integer relation coefficient to vanish
the outside v_p terms are Q-linearly independent and number at most dim_Q(V)

canonical_additive_readout.L_term: v belongs to one common fixed finite-dimensional Q-vector space V contained in R
canonical_additive_readout.M_term: q belongs to Qbar intersect R_{>0} and q^2 is an S_Q-unit
canonical_additive_readout.A_term: alpha belongs to Qbar intersect R
canonical_additive_readout.target_independence: all maps, weights, coefficients, supports, normalizations, and assembly operations are frozen independently of the target prime
allowed_operations: finite rational sums, differences, repetitions, and rational scalings of L terms
finite rational sums of real logarithms of positive M moduli, after adjoining positive algebraic roots
negative rational multiplier powers via inversion
finite sums and algebraic scalings of safely evaluated real algebraic A terms
excluded_operations: algebraic irrational coefficients on multiplier logarithms
arbitrary nonlinear mixing of component outputs
a logarithm applied after an algebraic action
point-dependent roofs without a proved common finite-rank space

s_unit_definition.definition: A nonzero algebraic x is an S_Q-unit when its additive valuation is zero at every finite place not above a rational prime in S_Q, in any number field containing x after exceptional places are saturated above S_Q.
s_unit_definition.rational_power_rule: after adjoining the unique positive real algebraic roots, if each q_j^2 is an S_Q-unit then q^2 for q=product(q_j^(c_j)), c_j in Q, is also an S_Q-unit
s_unit_definition.certified_object: q^2, not necessarily q in the original field

class_L.architecture: finite family of finite directed graphs with fixed finite-memory locally constant readouts
class_L.higher_block_rule: fixed finite memory is absorbed into a finite higher-block graph
class_L.combined_space: V=span_Q of every edge readout across the finite architecture
class_L.nonclaim: general point-dependent Holder roofs and matrix-cocycle spectral radii need not have finite rational rank

class_M.architecture: finite family of finite compositions of monic area-preserving generalized Henon factors of degree at least two over S-integer rings
periodic_coordinate_certificate: expand a periodic orbit into the cyclic scalar recurrence
retain cyclic neighbor multiplicities, including the doubled neighbor in a one-step cycle
homogenize each recurrence equation to its own degree
monicity removes every projective point at infinity
a projective variety contained in an affine chart is projective and affine and therefore zero-dimensional
the nonarchimedean maximum argument proves integrality outside the fixed bad places
multiplier_certificate: derivative factors, monodromy, and inverse monodromy are integral with determinant one outside the bad places
return eigenvalues are units outside those places
pass to a normal extension and saturate all places over S_Q before conjugation
q^2=lambda*conjugate(lambda) is an S_Q-unit for q=abs(lambda)>0
class_M.forbidden_shortcut: do not identify conjugate(lambda) with reciprocal(lambda)
class_M.nonclaim: the certificate does not assert algebraicity of log(abs(lambda)), classify arbitrary irrational moduli, or treat approximate primes

class_A.architecture: algebraic exact-symplectic maps with single-valued Qbar-rational potentials, algebraic periodic points, regular evaluation, and target-independent algebraic normalizations
allowed_algebraic_terms: finite algebraic endpoint, step, and gauge shifts
class_A.gauge_distinction: algebraic endpoint and gauge shifts preserve algebraicity whether or not they cancel; endpoint compatibility is required for canonical gauge invariance

boundary_controls.expected: a formal rank-r graph with r deliberately inserted independent labels realizes r labels; no target enumeration is performed and the construction is target injection
a=-15/16 and fixed point (5/4,5/4) give exact trace 5/2, determinant 1, and eigenvalues 2 and 1/2; the displayed support is already bad
the identity exact map on A^2 with symbolic constant potential LOG_2 has action LOG_2 and deliberately violates algebraic normalization; no numeric logarithm is evaluated
repeated orbit certificates for one formal prime label count once, and any one valid certificate may be selected before a relation
q=1, negative powers, and rational powers are admitted under positivity and finite-extension unit rules

necessary_failures: lose the common finite-rank locally constant space V
lose the fixed finite bad-prime support S_Q for squared moduli
lose real-algebraic target-independent action evaluation or normalization
leave the rational additive normal form and prove a new observable theorem

forbidden_data: generated or embedded enumerated prime target arrays
parameter, coefficient, support, representation rule, normalization, or architecture selection after target inspection
nearest-prime routines, floating tolerances, numerical fitting, or approximate equality promoted to exact evidence
network retrieval during the registered audit
fixed_control_constant_exception: the single exact rational constant 2 in K002 and the symbolic token LOG_2 in K003 are frozen boundary controls, not a prime table, target array, search, or candidate match
forbidden_claims: a universal no-go theorem for finite-dimensional or smooth symplectic maps
a complete, mutually exclusive, or exhaustive escape trichotomy
escape from a certificate is sufficient for arithmetic provenance
historical priority or a first theorem claim
finite rational rank for general Holder roofs
classification of arbitrary irrational multiplier moduli
algebraicity of multiplier logarithms or return times
a Riemann-zero, determinant, quantization, or Route-B result
